_comment: בנק סצנות אווירה ל-ELORINE. נגזר ישירות מפוסטי האווירה האמיתיים בפיד: כיסא ראטן וכובע קש מול קיר סיד עם צל חד, דלת קשת פתוחה אל הים עם וילון פשתן ורצפת טרקוטה, ואגרטל קרמיקה מט עם פרחים יבשים וקערת אבן על מדף. אותה פלטה בכל תמונה: קרם, עצם, חול, טרקוטה, שיזוף. חפצים אמיתיים, אור יום כיווני עם צורת צל ברורה, בלי אנשים ובלי בגדים.

scenes.prompt: A cane and rattan armchair standing against a rough whitewashed lime-plaster wall, a woven straw sun hat and a straw tote resting on the seat, a soft cream linen throw slipping over the armrest, worn terracotta floor tiles below and a pair of tan leather sandals on the floor beside it. Hard late-morning Mediterranean sun through a window casts one crisp diagonal shadow across the wall. Warm cream, sand and terracotta only. Nobody in frame
scenes.caption: כובע קש, תיק וסנדלים - כל מה שצריך לאחר צהריים אחד.

scenes.prompt: The inside of a whitewashed Mediterranean house looking out through a tall open arched doorway onto a terrace and the sea beyond, a sheer white linen curtain lifting in the breeze across the opening, warm terracotta floor tiles running toward the door with afternoon sunlight pooling on them, an olive branch in a rough clay jug on a stone ledge in the foreground. Cream plaster, terracotta and deep turquoise water. Nobody in frame
scenes.caption: רוח מהים, וילון לבן ואור של אחר הצהריים.

scenes.prompt: A styled still life on a pale stone ledge against a warm cream plaster wall: a matte round cream ceramic vase holding tall dried gypsophila, a shallow raw stone bowl beside it with a fine gold chain resting inside, and ivory silk fabric draped and pooling across the ledge. Soft directional daylight from the side draws a gentle shadow of the dried stems onto the wall. Warm monochrome cream, bone and sand. Nobody in frame
scenes.caption: אגרטל, פרח יבש וקו זהב דק.

scenes.prompt: An elegant tissue-wrapped parcel tied with a narrow ivory silk ribbon resting on a pale stone table beside a folded linen cloth, warm side light from a window, shallow depth of field, bone white and warm sand tones. Nobody in frame
scenes.caption: כל שמלה יוצאת מאיתנו ככה - עטופה, קשורה בסרט.

scenes.prompt: A small round stone table on a terracotta-tiled terrace with two cane bistro chairs, a linen napkin and a clear glass of water on the table, a woven straw bag hooked over one chair back, a whitewashed wall behind. Long warm late-afternoon shadows stretch across the tiles. Cream, terracotta and tan only. Nobody in frame
scenes.caption: אחר צהריים ארוך, ושום מקום למהר אליו.

scenes.prompt: A rounded niche carved into a thick cream lime-plaster wall holding a tall unglazed terracotta amphora with a few olive branches in it, the plaster hand-troweled and slightly uneven. A hard stripe of midday sun falls across the niche and leaves the rest in soft warm shade. Cream, clay and dusty olive green. Nobody in frame
scenes.caption: גומחה, כד וענף זית.

scenes.prompt: A woven straw tote bag sitting on worn pale stone steps outside a whitewashed house, a soft cream linen scarf spilling out of it, a pair of flat tan leather sandals on the step below. Strong Mediterranean sun and one clean shadow edge across the stone. Sand, cream and tan. Nobody in frame
scenes.caption: מדרגות אבן, תיק קש, ובוקר שלם.

scenes.prompt: Sheer cream linen curtains hanging over a tall open window in a plaster room, lifting slightly in the breeze, warm daylight passing through them and pooling as a soft rectangle of light on the terracotta tile floor. The room is nearly empty. Warm bone white and terracotta. Nobody in frame
scenes.caption: חלון פתוח, פשתן ואור על הרצפה.

scenes.prompt: A small cane side table against a warm cream plaster wall holding a matte stoneware cup and a single dried flower stem in a narrow ceramic bud vase. The striped shadow of a wooden shutter falls across the wall and the tabletop. Quiet, minimal, warm neutral. Nobody in frame
scenes.caption: ספל אחד, ענף אחד, בוקר שקט.

scenes.prompt: A close still life on a travertine ledge: a slim brushed gold cuff bracelet and a pair of pearl drop earrings resting on a fold of raw ivory silk, a small matte cream ceramic dish beside them. Very soft diffused daylight, warm neutral palette, jewellery only. Nobody in frame
scenes.caption: פרט קטן שמשלים הכל.

scenes.prompt: A young olive tree in a large unglazed terracotta pot standing in the corner of a whitewashed stone terrace, silver-green leaves catching low late-afternoon sun, a long soft shadow of the tree stretching across the pale stone floor and up the wall. scenes.prompt: A neat stack of folded cream and bone linen cloths on a pale stone ledge, a shallow ceramic dish with a few dried wheat stalks resting on top, warm plaster wall behind. Soft directional window light, gentle shadow, warm monochrome. Nobody in frame
scenes.caption: פשתן מקופל, ורוגע.

rules: This is a mood image, not a product image. No dresses, no clothing on display, no models, no people, no hands, no body parts.
No text, no logos, no lettering, no printed packaging of any kind anywhere in the image.
It must look like a real photograph of a real place or a real styled still-life set — shot on a camera, not rendered.

PALETTE LOCK: warm neutrals only — cream, bone, sand, tan, terracotta, pale stone — with at most one restrained accent (dusty olive green, muted brass or gold, or Mediterranean turquoise sea seen far away). No bright, saturated or cool colours anywhere.

Build the frame from REAL TANGIBLE OBJECTS in this world: rattan and cane, woven straw, linen and silk cloth, unglazed terracotta and matte ceramic, pale stone and travertine, lime plaster, dried flowers, olive branches, tan leather, slim gold. Not abstract textures.
Give the frame either honest depth — a room, a doorway, a terrace, a corner — or a composed still life on a surface. Never an extreme macro abstraction and never a flat empty texture.
Directional daylight with a clear, readable shadow shape: a diagonal across a wall, a shutter stripe, a pool of light on the floor. The light is part of the composition.
Quiet luxury: restrained, unstyled, slightly imperfect and lived-in. Not a stock photo, not a catalogue render.
Shot as if on 35mm or 50mm f/2.0, very light 35mm film grain, medium-low contrast, lifted blacks, no vignette.
